# Task 31 fixtures

The desktop tests create an ephemeral Python process from an inline repository-authored script (repository license). It reads the real launch pipe, records its PID under a temporary directory, and remains alive until the production panel controller terminates it. It does not replace page rendering or the public MCP service. Expected effects: a live child before session disposal; no live child after disposal. No credentials or user content.

Public rendering candidate: https://mcp.chess.niklas.sh/mcp, get-daily-puzzle, ext-apps resource. The original resource requires declared network capabilities; exact HTTPS resource/connect/base grants were explicitly authorized and the untouched public page passed desktop loading and solution interaction acceptance. Redirects and new windows stay denied. Do not treat the process fixture as public-page acceptance.
